mapper.select: select r.row_id rowId, r.batch_id batchId, r.employee_id employeeId, r.version, r.status, r.match_type matchType, r.task_id taskId, r.source_event_version sourceEventVersion, r.historical_supplement historicalSupplement, r.snapshot_json snapshotJson, b.shop_dept_id shopDeptId, b.file_sha256 fileSha256, b.created_by_user_id ownerUserId from oa_sign_onboard_import_row r join oa_sign_onboard_import_batch b on b.batch_id = r.batch_id where r.batch_id = #{batchId} and r.row_id = #{rowId} for update

select task_id taskId, employee_id employeeId, assigned_hr_user_id assignedHrUserId, scenario, source_type sourceType, source_business_id sourceBusinessId, source_event_version sourceEventVersion from oa_sign_task where task_id = #{taskId} or (employee_id = #{employeeId} and upper(trim(scenario)) = 'ONBOARD' and upper(trim(source_type)) = 'MANUAL_SIGN_EXCEL_IMPORT' and binary trim(source_business_id) = binary cast(#{rowId} as char) and binary trim(source_event_version) = binary cast(#{sourceEventVersion} as char)) order by task_id for update

select r.row_id rowId, r.batch_id batchId, r.employee_id employeeId, r.version, r.status, r.match_type matchType, r.task_id taskId, r.source_event_version sourceEventVersion, r.historical_supplement historicalSupplement, r.snapshot_json snapshotJson, b.shop_dept_id shopDeptId, b.file_sha256 fileSha256, b.created_by_user_id ownerUserId from oa_sign_onboard_import_row r join oa_sign_onboard_import_batch b on b.batch_id = r.batch_id where r.batch_id = #{batchId} and r.row_id = #{rowId}

select task_id taskId, employee_id employeeId, assigned_hr_user_id assignedHrUserId, scenario, source_type sourceType, source_business_id sourceBusinessId, source_event_version sourceEventVersion from oa_sign_task where task_id = #{taskId} or (employee_id = #{employeeId} and upper(trim(scenario)) = 'ONBOARD' and upper(trim(source_type)) = 'MANUAL_SIGN_EXCEL_IMPORT' and binary trim(source_business_id) = binary cast(#{rowId} as char) and binary trim(source_event_version) = binary cast(#{sourceEventVersion} as char)) order by task_id

select employee_id employeeId, source_row_id sourceRowId, source_version sourceVersion, salary_json salaryJson from sys_employee_salary_import_audit where employee_id = #{employeeId} order by audit_id desc limit 1

select employee_id employeeId, source_row_id sourceRowId, source_version sourceVersion, salary_json salaryJson from sys_employee_salary_import_audit where source_row_id = #{rowId} and source_version = #{version}
mapper.update: update sys_user_profile set base_salary = #{salary.baseSalary}, post_salary = #{salary.postSalary}, field_allowance = #{salary.fieldAllowance}, performance_salary = #{salary.performanceSalary}, salary_total = #{salary.salaryTotal}, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = sysdate() where user_id = #{employeeId}
mapper.insert: insert into sys_employee_salary_import_audit (employee_id, source_batch_id, source_row_id, source_version, source_file_sha256, before_json, salary_json, operator_user_id, operator_name, create_time) values (#{source.employeeId}, #{source.batchId}, #{source.rowId}, #{source.version}, #{source.fileSha256}, #{beforeJson}, #{salaryJson}, #{operatorId}, #{operator}, sysdate())
